focus: Adversarial replay - one falsification attempt per active P1 against the live tree, then the evidence/scope/coverage gates and the terminal STOP decision

findingDetails.title: Env reference sources advisor variables from the deleted tree and documents hook-walk targets the live shim no longer uses
findingDetails.evidence: Refinement found while attacking the finding: the stale surface is the whole advisor-owned block, not its edges. rg -c "mcp-server" returns 30 hits. Lines 318 and 366 do not just carry dead paths, they make false operational claims: 'pinned true in the runtime configs (.claude/mcp.json, .codex/config.toml, opencode.json)' and 'Set in the committed MCP registrations, and callers cannot forge it', while rg -n "SKILL_ADVISOR_DOC_TRIGGERS" over those three configs exits 1 with no matches - the launcher supplies the defaults instead (.opencode/bin/system-skill-advisor-launcher.cjs:84-85).
findingDetails.recommendation: Rewrite the advisor-owned block against runtime/ and describe the launcher-supplied defaults, or move the block behind an explicit historical banner; do not leave operators reading a trust-default and doc-trigger story that no longer has a registrations leg.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Re-read the whole file section under attack rather than the cited lines; the 30-hit count covers lines 303-366 plus the hook-walk entries at 142/148/193-194.
